summary.zh: 在对话里查地点、路线和天气，在高德地图里出发
summary.en: Search places, plan routes and check weather in chat, then continue in Amap Maps

description.zh: 搜索地点、查看周边、把坐标还原成地址、规划驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线和查询天气，结果以卡片展示；点卡片可在高德地图里查看与导航。高德 Key 只保存在本机，导航和打车在高德地图内完成。
description.en: Search places, explore nearby spots, turn coordinates into addresses, plan driving, transit, walking and cycling routes, and check weather. Results appear as cards you can open in Amap Maps. The key stays on this device; navigation and rides happen inside Amap Maps.

summary.zh: 消息、日历、云文档与邮箱
summary.en: Messages, calendar, docs and mail

description.zh: 连接飞书账号后，可以在对话里读写消息、日历、云文档、云空间、邮箱与任务；在插件页完成安装、连接与权限管理。
description.en: Connect your Feishu account to read and write messages, calendar, docs, drive, mail and tasks in chat; install, connect and manage permissions from the plugin page.

summary.zh: 搜索 RollingGo 酒店、查看房型与订单、创建待支付订单与取消订单
summary.en: Search RollingGo hotels, view rooms and orders, create or cancel a booking

description.zh: 连接 RollingGo 后，在对话里按预算、距离、标签和品牌筛选酒店，查看实时房型、创建待支付订单、查订单与取消订单；结果以卡片展示，支付在 RollingGo 官方页面完成。插件页管理服务安装、更新与登录，不需要 API Key。
description.en: Connect RollingGo to filter hotels by budget, distance, tags and brand, view live rooms, create a pending booking, check orders and cancel a booking from chat. Results appear as cards; payment happens on the official RollingGo page. The plugin page manages installation, updates and sign-in, with no API key.

summary.zh: 接入 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱，让 PI 读信、找邮件、起草与发送
summary.en: Connect IMAP/SMTP mailboxes so PI can read, search, draft and send

description.zh: 用授权码或应用专用密码接入 QQ、163、126、腾讯企业邮、阿里云邮箱、Gmail、iCloud、Fastmail、Yahoo、Zoho 与自定义 IMAP/SMTP 邮箱。插件提供邮件列表、会话阅读、写信与账户管理，并让 Agent 搜索、阅读、归档邮件、起草回复；你明确要求时可以让 Agent 直接发送。
description.en: Connect QQ, 163, 126, Tencent Exmail, Alibaba Mail, Gmail, iCloud, Fastmail, Yahoo, Zoho or any custom IMAP/SMTP mailbox with an authorization code or app password. The plugin provides message list, conversation reading, composing and account management, and lets the agent search, read, archive and draft replies; when you ask it to send, it can send directly.

summary.zh: 读取小米云服务中的笔记、待办、相册、短信、联系人与录音
summary.en: Read notes, to-dos, photos, SMS, contacts and recordings from Xiaomi Cloud services

description.zh: 连接小米账号后读取小米云服务中的笔记、待办、短信、联系人、相册与录音；笔记和待办可新建、修改与删除。首次使用需在插件页面完成小米账号登录。
description.en: Read notes, to-dos, SMS, contacts, photos and recordings from Xiaomi Cloud after signing in; notes and to-dos can be created, edited and deleted. Sign in from the plugin page first.

summary.zh: 查询 12306 车次、时刻与余票，去 12306 完成预订
summary.en: Search 12306 trains, times and seats, then book on 12306

description.zh: 按出发站、到达站和出发日期查询中国铁路 12306 车次、时刻、历时与余票，保存最近路线；结果可在聊天里查看全部车次并一键打开 12306 完成登录与购票。
description.en: Search China Railway 12306 trains by route and date with times, duration and seat availability, keep recent routes, and jump to 12306 to sign in and book.

summary.zh: 滴滴车型预估、创建订单、订单与司机位置
summary.en: Didi estimates, order creation, ride status and driver location

description.zh: 在对话里搜索地点、预估车型与价格、创建滴滴订单、查询订单与司机位置；也可生成滴滴 App/小程序发单链接。滴滴 Key 加密保存在本机；支付在滴滴内完成，插件不会自动支付。
description.en: Search places, estimate ride options and fares, create Didi orders, and check orders and driver locations from chat; also generate Didi app or mini program booking links. The Didi key is stored encrypted on this device; payment happens in Didi and the plugin never pays automatically.

summary.zh: 教务、在线教学、体育场馆与网费
summary.en: Academics, LMS, sports venues, and campus network

description.zh: 在 Linux 运行环境里使用 Node.js 版校园 CLI：课表、成绩、作业、课件下载、体育场馆预约、网费查询与续费。账号密码只在插件页使用，首次打开会自动安装。
description.en: Use the Node.js campus CLI inside the Linux runtime: timetable, grades, assignments, course files, sports venue booking, and campus network fees. Credentials are handled on the plugin page; the CLI installs itself on first use.

summary.zh: 八套精选配色，为 PI 换一种气质
summary.en: Eight curated palettes that give PI a different mood

description.zh: 为主题库加入海盐、苔原、晚霞、樱、墨玉、夜航、咖啡与石墨八套主题，四浅四深；文字、按钮与代码在每套主题下都清晰可读。
description.en: Adds eight themes to the library — Harbor, Tundra, Dusk, Sakura, Jade, Nightfall, Mocha and Graphite — four light and four dark, with readable text, buttons and code in every one.

summary.zh: 按日期范围导出完整微信记录，交给 Agent 总结
summary.en: Export complete WeChat records for a date range and let the agent summarize

description.zh: 在 Linux 运行环境里同步并解密微信本地数据库，按日期范围导出完整聊天记录，交给 Agent 阅读和总结。导出保留全部会话与消息，不做筛选或摘要；公众号、文件传输助手、服务通知和支付记录都会保留。需要把系统访问切到 Root。
description.en: Sync and decrypt the local WeChat database in the Linux runtime, then export complete chat records for a date range for the agent to read and summarize. Every conversation and message is kept, with no filtering or summarizing; official accounts, file transfer, service notices and payments are included. Requires Root system access.

summary.zh: 消息、邮件、文档、日程与待办
summary.en: Messages, mail, docs, calendar and to-dos

description.zh: 连接企业微信后，可以在对话里处理消息、邮件、文档、日程与待办；在插件页完成安装与扫码授权。
description.en: Connect WeCom to handle messages, mail, docs, calendar and to-dos in chat; install and scan to authorize from the plugin page.

summary.zh: 赞噢校园集市 · 作者资料与历史检索
summary.en: Zanao market with author profiles and history search

description.zh: 内置 Token 捕捉器与离线签名 CLI，可浏览、发帖（支持图片），并支持查看帖子/评论的作者资料、按昵称或头像检索历史帖子。
description.en: Bundled token catcher and offline-signing CLI: browse, post with images, view post/comment author profiles, and search history by nickname or avatar.

summary.zh: 按平台规格批量产出广告文案并逐条校验
summary.en: Write ad copy in bulk and check every line against platform limits

description.zh: 为 Google、Meta、LinkedIn、TikTok 等平台生成响应式广告的标题、正文和多组变体。每条文案都会对照平台字数上限与政策要求检查，适合正式投放前成稿。
description.en: Generates RSA headlines, body copy and bulk variations for Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok. Every line is checked against platform character limits and policy rules, so it is ready to review before launch.

summary.zh: 评审 REST 接口改动，查规范与破坏性变更
summary.en: Review REST endpoint changes for conventions and breaking changes.

description.zh: 在合并或批准之前评审新增、变更的 REST 接口，检查命名与约定是否一致，标出会影响现有调用方的破坏性变更，并给出设计评分。适合接口 PR 和设计文档评审。评分脚本需要 Python 环境。
description.en: Reviews new or changed REST endpoints before merge: naming and conventions, changes that break existing callers, and a design score. Fits endpoint PRs and design docs. The scoring scripts need Python.

summary.zh: 对照 Apple 人机界面指南检查界面
summary.en: Check iOS and macOS UI against Apple's HIG

description.zh: 对照 Apple 人机界面指南审查 iOS、macOS、watchOS 和 visionOS 的界面，覆盖 Liquid Glass、对比度、点击区域和布局细节。适合在设计评审或上线前逐项核对规范，并拿到可执行的整改建议。需要本地 Python 环境运行配套检查脚本。
description.en: Audits iOS, macOS, watchOS and visionOS UI against Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, covering Liquid Glass, contrast, tap targets and layout. Use it for design review or pre-release checks. Needs Python locally for the checker.

summary.zh: 分析文章结构并插入合适的插图
summary.en: Place well-matched illustrations in an article

description.zh: 先读文章结构，标出需要配图的位置，再按类型、风格、配色三个维度生成插图。适合长文发布前补齐配图。需要可用的图像生成服务。
description.en: Reads an article's structure, marks where a visual would help, then generates illustrations along type, style and palette. Suited to finishing long posts before publishing. Requires an image generation service.

summary.zh: 为文章生成多种风格的封面图
summary.en: Generate cover images for articles

description.zh: 按类型、配色、渲染、文字和氛围五个维度设计封面，内置 11 套配色和 7 种渲染风格。支持电影感 2.35:1、宽屏 16:9 和方形 1:1 三种画幅。生成图片需要可用的图像生成后端。
description.en: Designs article covers across five dimensions: type, palette, rendering, text and mood, with 11 palettes and 7 rendering styles. Supports cinematic 2.35:1, widescreen 16:9 and square 1:1 crops. Requires an image generation backend.

summary.zh: 给杂乱文本补上标题、摘要和层级
summary.en: Give rough text headings, summary and structure

description.zh: 把纯文本或松散的 Markdown 整理成规整文档，补齐属性头、标题、摘要、各级标题、列表和代码块。适合发布前清一遍草稿。结果另存为带有 formatted 后缀的新文件。
description.en: Turns plain text or loose Markdown into a tidy document with frontmatter, title, summary, headings, lists and code blocks. Useful for cleaning up a draft before publishing. Saves the result to a new file with a formatted suffix.

summary.zh: 生成高密度信息长图
summary.en: Build dense one-page infographics

description.zh: 提供 21 种版式和 22 种视觉风格，会先读内容再给出推荐搭配，然后产出可直接发布的信息图。适合把报告、文章浓缩成一页大图。生成图片需要可用的图像生成后端。
description.en: Picks a layout from 21 types and a style from 22 options after reading the content, then renders a publication-ready infographic. Good for compressing reports or articles into one tall image. Needs an image generation backend.

summary.zh: 把 Markdown 转成带样式的网页
summary.en: Convert Markdown into styled, WeChat-ready HTML

description.zh: 把 Markdown 渲染成带主题样式的 HTML，兼容公众号排版，支持代码高亮、公式、脚注和提示块。Mermaid 与 PlantUML 图也能一并处理，外链可自动收进文末引用。渲染 Mermaid 需要本机安装 headless Chrome。
description.en: Renders Markdown to themed, WeChat-friendly HTML with code highlighting, math, footnotes and callouts. Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams are supported, and links can move to a footnote list. Mermaid needs headless Chrome.

summary.zh: 把内容做成可滚动浏览的幻灯片图片
summary.en: Turn content into scrollable slide images

description.zh: 先产出大纲和风格说明，再逐页生成幻灯片图片，版式偏向自行阅读和转发。适合做图文演示、课程讲义或社交平台分享。需要可用的图像生成后端。
description.en: Outlines a deck with style directions, then generates each slide as an image. Designed for reading and sharing rather than live presenting, so pages stay self-explanatory. Requires an image generation backend.

summary.zh: 在快翻、常规、精翻三档间翻译文章
summary.en: Translate articles in three depth modes

description.zh: 支持中英互译，可在快翻、常规、精翻三档之间选择，也能挂自定义术语表。适合翻译外文长文、做本地化，或把已有译文再打磨一遍。抓取链接内容需要联网。
description.en: Translates text or a linked page between Chinese and English in quick, normal or refined mode, with optional custom glossaries. Good for long articles, localization or tightening a draft. Fetching a URL needs network access.

summary.zh: 把内容拆成适合社交平台传播的图卡
summary.en: Turn content into shareable social image cards

description.zh: 把一段内容拆成 1 到 10 张卡通风格图片卡片，提供 12 种视觉风格、8 种版式和 3 套配色可选。适合小红书种草、微信图文这类需要连续多图呈现的场景。生成图片需要可用的图像生成后端。
description.en: Breaks a piece of writing into 1 to 10 cartoon-style cards, with 12 visual styles, 8 layouts and 3 palettes to choose from. Built for Xiaohongshu and WeChat posts that need a scrollable card series. An image generation backend is required.

summary.zh: 把书或文档整理成可查阅的知识库
summary.en: Compile a book or docs folder into a skill knowledge base.

description.zh: 把一本书、一套文档或规格集整理成结构化的知识库，含章节摘要、术语表和速查表，便于按需查阅而不是整本重读。支持 PDF、EPUB、DOCX、HTML 和 Markdown 输入，处理受版权保护的材料前会先做授权检查。
description.en: Turns a book or docs folder into a knowledge base with chapter summaries, a glossary and a cheatsheet, built for lookup rather than rereading. Accepts PDF, EPUB, DOCX, HTML and Markdown; copyrighted material passes a rights check first.

summary.zh: 动手实现前先梳理需求与方案
summary.en: Shape the idea before writing code

description.zh:
在开始写代码或做任何创作前，用对话把需求、约束与可选方案梳理清楚。
产出经过确认的设计，再进入实现。
适合新功能、组件、行为改动或任何从零开始的计划。
description.en:
Use a guided conversation to clarify requirements, constraints, and options before any creative work.
Confirm a direction first, then move into implementation.
Great for new features, components, behavior changes, or any plan from scratch.

summary.zh: 先访谈品牌调性，再产出可部署落地页
summary.en: Interview brand direction, then ship a landing page

description.zh: 通过品牌访谈确定配色、字体与形状语言，再据此生成单页落地页并反复调整细节。适合产品已有但缺少视觉方向时制作首页或推广页。需要联网并配置 Stitch 的 API Key。
description.en: Runs a brand interview on colors, typography and shape language, then generates and refines a single landing page with deployable HTML. Suits products without an established visual direction. Requires network access and a Stitch API key.

summary.zh: 检验名称在目标地区的发音、歧义与可信度
summary.en: Test pronunciation, meaning and trust per region

description.zh: 为公司、品牌或产品名做跨地区检验：发音是否顺口、是否带有不雅含义、在当地是否可信，并给出替代名称建议。适合定名前后、准备进入新地区时使用。
description.en: Checks a company, brand or product name across target regions for pronunciation, unintended meanings and local trust, then suggests alternatives. Use it before committing to a name or entering a new region.

summary.zh: 生成海报与平面作品的 PNG、PDF 成品
summary.en: Produce posters and static artwork as PNG and PDF files.

description.zh: 先确立一套视觉主张，再据此绘制海报、艺术画等静态画面，输出 PNG 或 PDF。适合需要原创平面视觉的场合，只做新设计，不模仿现成作品。生成 PDF 需要可用的排版工具链。
description.en: Establishes a visual direction first, then renders posters and static artwork as PNG or PDF. Meant for original graphic work, with no reuse of existing artists' pieces. PDF output needs a working layout toolchain.

summary.zh: 公司层面的融资、战略与组织抉择
summary.en: Company-level counsel on funding, strategy and organization

description.zh: 面向 CEO 和创始人，处理董事会与投资人关系、融资还是收缩、战略押注、组织与文化等公司层面问题。适合需要有人站在经营全局给出判断，而不是只谈某个职能的时候。
description.en: Counsel for CEOs and founders on company-level matters: board and investor trouble, raising versus cutting, strategy bets, organization and culture. For moments that need a whole-company view rather than one function's answer.

summary.zh: 算清现金能撑多久与单位经济
summary.en: Startup finance for runway, unit economics and dilution

description.zh: 处理创业公司的财务问题，包括现金储备与烧钱速度、LTV 与 CAC、回本周期、融资与股权稀释。在问到现金还能撑多久、烧钱是否过快，或给出 ARR、CAC 数据时使用。适合融资前后做一次财务体检。
description.en: Startup finance: runway and burn, LTV and CAC, payback period, fundraising and dilution. Comes in when someone asks how long cash lasts, or brings ARR and CAC numbers. Works before or after a raise.

summary.zh: 按项目技术栈生成 lint、测试、构建和部署流水线
summary.en: Generate a CI/CD workflow from the stack the repository uses

description.zh: 识别仓库的技术栈后，生成包含 lint、测试、构建和部署的 CI/CD 工作流，可直接放进仓库使用。适合新项目还没有 CI、想把测试挂到 push 上，或需要一份能跑通的流水线定义时使用。部署步骤需要在平台上配置凭据与运行环境。
description.en: Detects the repo's stack, then generates a CI/CD workflow that runs lint, tests, build and deploy, ready to drop into the repository. Use it for projects without CI. Deploy steps need credentials and runners on the platform.

summary.zh: 按语言规则评审代码并给出合并结论
summary.en: Review diffs in 14 languages and return a merge verdict

description.zh: 对 PR、diff、单个函数或整份文件做评审，按语言检查安全、异步与资源释放、错误处理和性能问题，给出阻断项、非阻断项与合并结论。覆盖 TypeScript、Python、Go、Rust、Java 等主流语言。
description.en: Reviews pull requests, diffs or a single function with per-language rules for security, async and resource handling, error handling and performance. Returns blocking and non-blocking findings plus a merge verdict.

summary.zh: 为未订阅客户撰写冷邮件及跟进序列
summary.en: Draft cold outreach and follow-up sequences for prospects

description.zh: 为未主动订阅的潜在客户撰写首次触达邮件和后续跟进序列，并按长度、个性化程度和垃圾邮件风险逐封打分。适合 SDR 外呼前检查初稿。
description.en: Writes first-touch emails and follow-up sequences for prospects who never opted in, then scores each message for length, personalization and spam risk. Useful for reviewing SDR drafts before sending.

summary.zh: 建立持续跟踪竞品的竞争情报体系
summary.en: A tracking system for competitors, battlecards and win/loss

description.zh: 做竞品分析、对战卡片、赢单与丢单复盘，以及相对替代方案的位置说明。形成的跟踪体系会同时服务定位、销售和产品路线图。适合竞品动作变多、销售需要统一话术的时候。
description.en: Competitor analysis, battlecards, win/loss reviews and positioning against alternatives. The tracking system it builds feeds positioning, sales conversations and the roadmap. For when competitors outrun the sales team.

summary.zh: 从定价、口碑、招聘等 12 个维度拆竞品
summary.en: Score rivals across 12 dimensions with SWOT and maps

description.zh: 从定价、用户评价、招聘、SEO 和 UX 等 12 个维度拆解竞争对手，给出评分、SWOT 和定位图。适合准备应对竞品动作，或需要向团队说明自身位置时使用。
description.en: Tears down a competitor across 12 dimensions including pricing, reviews, hiring, SEO and UX, with scores, SWOT and positioning maps. Use it to see where you stand or plan a response to a rival's move.

summary.zh: 改写生硬泛泛的草稿，让它读起来像真人写的
summary.en: Rewrite flat, robotic drafts so they read like a person wrote them

description.zh: 针对节奏单调、内容空泛的草稿，补充具体细节、语气变化和品牌个性，让文字不再像机器生成。适合用户反馈文案生硬、千篇一律或不像自己说话时使用。
description.en: Turns generic, robotic drafts into copy with rhythm, concrete details, personality and brand voice. Use it when readers say the text sounds like ChatGPT, feels bland, or does not sound like the brand.

summary.zh: 从调研、大纲到完稿写出一篇博客文章或指南
summary.en: Take a topic from research and outline to a finished blog post

description.zh: 按调研、提纲、成稿、SEO 优化和质量检查的顺序，写完一篇博客文章、教程或指南。适合交来一个选题或一堆零散笔记，需要直接得到可发布全文的时候。研究阶段需要联网查资料。
description.en: Writes a blog post, article or guide in order: research, outline, draft, SEO pass and quality gates. Use it when you hand over a topic or rough notes and want a publishable piece back. Needs web access for research.

summary.zh: 起草合同、提案、SOW 与 NDA 等文书
summary.en: Drafts contracts, proposals, SOWs and NDAs

description.zh: 按美国、欧盟、英国或 DACH 地区的常见做法，起草自由职业合同、项目提案、工作说明书、保密协议和主服务协议，输出结构化的 Markdown 并说明如何转成 Word。适合接单、外包或合作洽谈前准备文书。内容不构成法律意见，正式签署前仍需律师确认。
description.en: Drafts freelance contracts, proposals, statements of work, NDAs and MSAs for US, EU, UK and DACH jurisdictions in structured Markdown, with steps to convert to Word. Useful before a new engagement. Not legal advice.

summary.zh: 为标题、CTA 与落地页撰写并评分初稿
summary.en: Draft and score headlines, CTAs and landing page copy

description.zh: 撰写标题、标语、CTA、落地页、定价页和关于页文案，按页面区块结构成稿，候选标题先评分再定稿。适合从零写落地页，或重写关键转化页面时使用。
description.en: Writes headlines, taglines, CTAs, landing pages, pricing and about pages section by section, scoring candidate headlines before settling on one. Good for a new page or a rewrite of a key one.

summary.zh: 把分析结果讲成能推动决策的故事
summary.en: Turn analytics into a narrative that drives decisions.

description.zh: 用图表、背景和叙事结构把分析结果组织成有说服力的汇报，让结论对非技术受众也讲得通。做季度业务回顾、投资人材料或数据分析报告时使用。
description.en: Shapes charts, context and structure into a narrative that persuades. Use it for business reviews, investor decks and data reports aimed at non-technical audiences.

summary.zh: 用分治与性能剖析定位疑难缺陷
summary.en: Track down hard bugs with profiling and root cause analysis

description.zh: 给出复现、二分定位、日志排查与性能剖析工具的使用顺序，适用于跨语言栈的缺陷排查。适合线上故障、偶发错误和性能退化时使用。
description.en: A repeatable order for reproducing, bisecting, logging, and profiling across language stacks. Useful for production incidents, intermittent failures, and performance regressions.

summary.zh: 按章节导读《深度学习》，并对照今天的实践
summary.en: Read the Deep Learning book chapter by chapter, updated for today

description.zh: 把《深度学习》的二十章拆成可查的索引，标注从 2016 年到今天的观点变化，还能按目标规划阅读顺序、诊断训练问题。适合系统学习这本书、想确认其中某条建议如今是否仍然成立，或遇到训练故障时对照排查。
description.en: Indexes all twenty chapters of the Deep Learning book, flags what changed from 2016 to today, plans reading paths and diagnoses training problems. Use it while studying the book or checking whether its advice still holds.

summary.zh: 把任务分成深浅两类，排出能量优先的时间块
summary.en: Time-block a deep work day and cap shallow work

description.zh: 把待办按深度和浅度分类，排出以精力高峰为优先的时间块，深度工作总量控制在四小时以内，琐事集中到至多两个窗口。还能记录每次专注会话与连续天数，配合日终收尾流程。适合注意力被会议切碎、需要重新拿回整块时间的时候。
description.en: Classifies tasks as deep or shallow, builds an energy-first time-blocked schedule capped at four hours of deep work, batches shallow work into two windows and logs focus sessions with an end-of-day shutdown.

summary.zh: 拆解书或长文的论点与证据，并建立知识地图
summary.en: Reads a book or long document closely and maps its claims

description.zh: 用于深入读一本书、一篇文章、一份 PDF 或一组文档，提取其中的观点和支撑证据，梳理成知识地图，也可用费曼式讲解和回忆练习帮助掌握。提供快速、深读、地图、费曼和整书通读几种模式，适合需要真正读懂而不只是略读的场景。
description.en: Reads a book, article, PDF or document set closely: pulls out claims and evidence, builds a knowledge map, and supports Feynman-style explanation and recall. Includes quick, deep, map, Feynman and whole-book modes.

summary.zh: 在真实浏览器中检查界面能否交付
summary.en: Checks a rendered UI before it ships

description.zh: 在界面准备交付前检查实际渲染效果：找出点了没反应的控件、占位文案、被去掉的焦点样式，缺失的加载、空白和错误状态，以及对比度不足、点击区域过小、焦点被隐藏和布局错乱等问题。适合开发自测、设计走查或上线前验收，需要在真实浏览器中运行。
description.en: Checks a UI as rendered before it is called done: dead controls, placeholder copy, missing loading, empty and error states, removed focus rings, low contrast, small targets and broken reflow. Runs in a real browser.

summary.zh: 把互不依赖的任务拆开并行执行
summary.en: Split independent tasks across agents that run in parallel.

description.zh: 当有两项以上互不依赖、不共享状态的任务时，拆成并行子任务同时推进，再汇总结果。适合大范围检索、多文件改造这类可以切分的工作。需要运行环境支持子代理分发。
description.en: When two or more tasks have no shared state or ordering between them, splits the work into parallel subtasks and collects the results. Suits broad searches and multi-file changes. Requires a runtime that can dispatch subagents.

summary.zh: 分阶段协作写完文档，再验证读者能否读懂
summary.en: Co-write documents in stages, then check reader clarity.

description.zh: 按结构化流程推进文档、提案、技术规格和决策记录的撰写，逐轮补充背景并打磨内容。适合篇幅较长、需要反复确认重点的写作任务，也适合写完先检验目标读者能否看懂。
description.en: Guides writing of documents, proposals, specs and decision records in a structured loop, filling gaps round by round. Suits longer pieces whose key points need confirming, and checks that the intended reader can follow.

summary.zh: 编写、审查和优化 Dockerfile 与 compose 配置
summary.en: Write, review and optimize Dockerfiles and docker-compose files

description.zh: 编写、审查和优化 Dockerfile 与 docker-compose 配置，关注镜像分层、构建缓存、体积和安全性。适合在改容器配置前先过一遍，或镜像过大、构建过慢、配置报错的时候使用。本地分析需要 Python 环境，构建校验需要装好 Docker。
description.en: Reviews and optimizes Dockerfiles and docker-compose configs for layer count, build cache, image size and security. Use it before editing container config, or when builds are slow. Local analysis needs Python; build checks need Docker.

summary.zh: 读写编辑 Word 文档并生成规范排版
summary.en: Create, read and edit Word documents with professional formatting.

description.zh: 支持创建、读取和编辑 .docx 与 .dotx，可处理目录、标题、页码、表格、页眉，也能换图、查找替换和查看修订批注。适合把零散素材整理成报告、信函或模板。使用前需要安装文档处理依赖。
description.en: Creates, reads and edits .docx and .dotx files with headings, TOCs, page numbers, images, find-and-replace and tracked changes. Suits turning loose material into reports or templates. Needs document libraries installed.

summary.zh: 为会面或尽调准备公司个人档案
summary.en: Build decision-grade dossiers on a company or person for meetings.

description.zh: 研究指定的公司、个人或机构，用正反两面的证据检验你给出的判断，输出一份可交付的尽调档案。适合重要会面前做功课、投资尽调或合作方背景核查时使用。需要联网检索，成品为 .docx 文档。
description.en: Researches a specific company, person or organisation, tests your stated hypothesis against balanced evidence and delivers a .docx dossier. Useful before important meetings, investor diligence or partner checks. Needs web access.

summary.zh: 设计欢迎、培育、引导与唤回邮件序列的节奏
summary.en: Design welcome, nurture and win-back email sequences with timing

description.zh: 为已订阅用户规划滴灌、培育、上手引导、欢迎和唤回邮件序列：定发送节奏、触发条件和退出规则，并逐封写出内容。适合新用户引导、长期培育或挽回沉默用户时使用。序列检查脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Plans drip, nurture, onboarding, welcome and win-back sequences for opted-in users: timing, triggers, exit rules and copy for each email. Use it for a new-user flow, a nurture track or winning back quiet subscribers. Needs Python.

summary.zh: 做有视差与滚动叙事的电影感落地页
summary.en: Cinematic landing pages with parallax and scrollytelling

description.zh: 做有纵深感的落地页与首屏：视差、滚动叙事、分区叠压、文字进出场，风格接近 Apple 产品页，落地前先给视觉方案。基于静态图片和 CSS、JavaScript 实现，不需要 WebGL 或 3D 建模。
description.en: Builds immersive landing pages and hero sections with parallax, scrollytelling, overlapping sections and text reveals, in the spirit of Apple product pages. Works from flat images, CSS and JavaScript, no WebGL or 3D modeling needed.

summary.zh: 由主会话逐条执行实现计划并留下记录
summary.en: Execute an implementation plan task by task in one session.

description.zh: 在同一个会话里按计划逐项实现，用测试先失败再通过来验证每一步，并把决策记成可追溯的流水，最后做一次整体复查。适合计划已写好、想省掉逐任务分派开销的场合。
description.en: Works through an existing plan task by task in one session, proving each step with a test seen failing then passing, logging decisions, and ending with one full review. Suits plans where per-task dispatch costs more than it returns.

summary.zh: 设计 A/B 测试，估算样本量并解读结果
summary.en: Design A/B tests with sample size and result readouts

description.zh: 为产品功能规划 A/B 测试，写清假设、样本量、运行时长和优先级，并给出结果判读标准。适合在决定要不要做实验、实验跑多久，或拿到数据后判断是否显著时使用。
description.en: Plans product A/B tests with clear hypotheses, sample size, run length and priority, then helps read the results. Use it when asking what to test, how long to run, or whether a test actually won.

summary.zh: 在本地转换图片、音视频和文档格式
summary.en: Convert images, audio, video, and docs locally

description.zh: 在本机完成图片、音频、视频、文档和数据之间的格式转换，转换前确认源文件与目标要求，转换后校验输出是否可用。适合需要离线处理、文件不宜上传的场景。需要本机已安装 FFmpeg、ImageMagick、Pandoc 或 LibreOffice 等对应工具。
description.en: Converts image, audio, video, document, and data formats on your own machine, checking the source and verifying the result. Fits work that must stay offline. Requires the matching tool, such as FFmpeg, ImageMagick, Pandoc, or LibreOffice.

summary.zh: 分析财报、用 DCF 估值并解释预算差异
summary.en: Analyzes statements, values with a DCF, explains variance

description.zh: 分析财务报表，用现金流折现给公司估值，解释实际支出与预算的差异，并搭建滚动预测。适合投资评估、经营复盘或年度预算编制时做量化分析。
description.en: Analyzes financial statements, values a company with a DCF, explains why spend missed budget and builds rolling forecasts. Useful for investment review, operating check-ins or annual budgeting.

summary.zh: 帮创始人摆脱瓶颈、学会授权与分工
summary.en: Help founders delegate, recover energy, and grow into the CEO role.

description.zh: 针对创始人成为公司瓶颈、无法授权、精力透支，或从个人贡献者转向 CEO 的阶段给出建议。内容涵盖授权练习、精力与日程审计、盲区识别和继任安排。
description.en: For founders who have become the bottleneck, cannot let go, are running low, or are moving from individual contributor to CEO. Covers delegation practice, energy and calendar audits, blind spots, and succession.

summary.zh: 为新界面给出清晰的视觉方向与排版方案
summary.en: Set a clear visual direction and type system for new UI.

description.zh: 在新建或改造界面时提供审美方向、字体层级和配色决策，让成品不像套用默认模板。适合从零搭页面、或现有界面观感平庸需要重做视觉时使用。
description.en: Offers aesthetic direction, type hierarchy and color decisions when building or reshaping an interface, so the result does not read as a default template. Useful when starting a page from scratch or when an existing screen looks generic.

summary.zh: 用变基、拣选、二分与 reflog 处理复杂历史
summary.en: Handle complex history with rebase, bisect, and reflog

description.zh: 覆盖变基、cherry-pick、bisect、worktree 和 reflog 的用法，用于整理提交历史、定位引入回归的提交以及找回误删内容。适合多人协作的功能分支管理和仓库故障恢复。
description.en: Covers rebase, cherry-pick, bisect, worktrees, and reflog for cleaning up history, finding regression commits, and recovering lost work. Useful for feature-branch collaboration and repo troubleshooting.

summary.zh: 把零散信息整理成规范 issue
summary.en: Turn scattered notes into a clean issue

description.zh:
把错误日志、语音记录或截图整理成结构清晰的 GitHub issue。
支持附图与 GIF 作为证据，适合从非正式描述快速建单。
description.en:
Turn error logs, voice notes, or screenshots into a well-structured GitHub issue.
Supports images and GIFs as evidence, making it fast to file a clear issue.

summary.zh: 把当前对话整理成交接文档，供下一个会话接手
summary.en: Turn the current session into a handoff doc the next agent can pick up

description.zh: 把当前会话压缩成一份交接文档，写清目标、已定的决策、下一步和风险，并用路径或链接引用已有的 PRD、计划和提交，而不是复制内容。适合中途换人接手、收工前留档，或新会话需要接着做的时候。
description.en: Compacts the session into a handoff document covering goals, decisions, next steps and risks, and references existing PRDs, plans and commits by path instead of copying them. Use it when someone else takes over.

summary.zh: 设计微交互、动效与操作反馈
summary.en: Microinteractions, motion, and user feedback patterns.

description.zh: 规划按钮反馈、加载状态、转场动画与结果提示，让交互过程清楚可预期。适合打磨界面的细节体验，或为已有流程补上缺失的状态与反馈。
description.en: Plans button feedback, loading states, transitions, and result messaging so interactions stay predictable. Useful for polishing interface details or adding missing states and feedback to a flow.

summary.zh: 挑选指标并设计清晰的 KPI 看板
summary.en: Pick the right metrics and lay out a readable KPI dashboard.

description.zh: 从指标选择到可视化布局给出 KPI 看板的设计方法，覆盖经营数据、运营监控和留存分析等场景。搭建新看板，或排查指标口径不一致导致的数据矛盾时使用。
description.en: Covers metric selection and visual layout for KPI dashboards, from executive numbers to operations monitoring and retention views. Use it when building a dashboard or when figures disagree because definitions differ.

summary.zh: 评估发布就绪度，按渠道排出分阶段计划
summary.en: Score launch readiness and build a phased plan

description.zh: 为产品或功能发布做就绪度评估，并按渠道给出分阶段执行计划，覆盖预热、首发和后续跟进。适合临近上线、筹备 Product Hunt 首发、内测或等待名单时使用。
description.en: Assesses launch readiness and lays out a phased, per-channel plan covering warm-up, launch day and follow-through. Use it ahead of a release, a Product Hunt day, a beta or a waitlist.

summary.zh: 写或改领英帖子，含故事、教程与投票
summary.en: Write, edit and review LinkedIn posts of any format.

description.zh: 撰写或打磨 LinkedIn 帖子，覆盖故事、教程、轮播、视频脚本和投票几种形式。也能把已有草稿、博客文章或演讲稿改写成符合平台节奏的帖子。
description.en: Writes and edits LinkedIn posts in several formats: story, how-to, carousel, video script and poll. It can also turn an existing draft, blog post or talk into posts that fit the platform's pace.

summary.zh: 规划文献综述的检索策略与阅读框架
summary.en: Plan a literature review with PICO or SPIDER and a reading guide.

description.zh: 为文献综述选定 PICO、SPIDER 等检索框架，在 PubMed 和 OpenAlex 检索并整理成一份 .docx 入门指南。适合刚启动综述、需要先摸清领域脉络时使用。检索依赖联网，单篇论文查询直接提问即可。
description.en: Picks a PICO or SPIDER search frame, runs PubMed and OpenAlex queries and writes a .docx orientation guide for a literature review. Useful at the start of a review. Needs web access; single-paper lookups are best asked directly.

summary.zh: 把文章、论文或书籍整理进可持续维护的知识库
summary.en: Keep an Obsidian knowledge base current as sources come in

description.zh: 把论文、文章或书籍整理进 Obsidian 知识库，维护索引、链接和条目格式，并定期检查断链与重复。适合长期维护第二大脑、需要持续消化外部资料，或知识库越写越乱时使用。需要一个 Obsidian 库目录，整理脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Ingests papers, articles and books into an Obsidian vault, keeping the index, links and entry format in shape and flagging broken links over time. Use it for a long-lived second brain. Needs a vault directory and local Python.

summary.zh: 判断文档类型，转成对应的网页形式
summary.en: Identify the markdown type and pick its page format

description.zh: 判断一份 markdown 属于长文档、代码评审还是演示稿，再走对应的转换，输出单个可打开的 HTML 页面。适合不确定该用哪种形式呈现时，先让它分类再决定。转换前需要先设好品牌样式。
description.en: Classifies a markdown file as a long document, a code review or a deck, then routes it to the matching conversion and returns one self-contained HTML page. Set brand styles first.

summary.zh: 双口径测算规模，并估算样本量与客群分层
summary.en: Size a market, plan survey samples and score segments

description.zh: 同时用自上而下和自下而上两种方法测算 TAM、SAM、SOM，并对照两边的差异，避免只给一个没有出处的数字。还能按置信度和误差范围估算问卷样本量，筛掉规模不够或难以触达的客群切分。适合立项论证、融资材料和年度规划时需要可追溯依据的场合，需要本地 Python 3 环境。
description.en: Sizes TAM, SAM and SOM top-down and bottom-up side by side, shows where the two disagree, plans survey sample sizes per segment and drops segments that are too small or unreachable. Needs Python 3.

summary.zh: 构建高质量 MCP 服务器的指南
summary.en: Guide to building quality MCP servers

description.zh:
面向 Python(FastMCP)、Node/TypeScript 与 C#/.NET 的 MCP 服务器开发指南。
覆盖工具设计、评估、最佳实践与多语言模板，适合把外部 API 接入助手。
description.en:
A guide to building MCP servers in Python (FastMCP), Node/TypeScript, and C#/.NET.
Covers tool design, evaluation, best practices, and templates for exposing external APIs to assistants.

summary.zh: 把规范文档转成带目录和搜索的网页
summary.en: Long-form markdown into one HTML page with search

description.zh: 把规范、RFC、报告或方案这类长文 markdown 转成单个 HTML 页面，带固定目录、全文搜索和代码块复制。适合需要把文档发给别人阅读、又不想依赖在线平台的时候。转换前需先设定品牌样式。
description.en: Converts long-form markdown such as specs, RFCs, reports or plans into one HTML page with a sticky table of contents, search and code copy. Good for sharing readable docs without a hosting platform.

summary.zh: 把代码评审笔记整理成双栏网页报告
summary.en: Turn markdown code reviews into a two-column HTML report

description.zh: 把带有 diff 片段和严重程度标注的 markdown 代码评审转成双栏 HTML 报告，左右对照查看改动与说明。适合评审结束后需要一份易读、可存档的结果时使用。转换时要指定评审人姓名，并先设定品牌样式。
description.en: Turns a markdown code review with diff blocks and severity callouts into a two-column HTML report. Good when a review must be readable and archivable. A named reviewer and brand styles are required.

summary.zh: 把笔记变成可翻页的网页幻灯片
summary.en: Turn markdown notes into a single-file slide deck

description.zh: 把 markdown 文件转成一个可独立打开的网页幻灯片，支持键盘翻页、演讲者备注和打印成 PDF。适合讲稿或笔记已经写好、需要快速做出演示稿并方便分发的时候。生成结果是单个文件，不需要服务器。
description.en: Turns a markdown file into one self-contained HTML deck with keyboard navigation, presenter notes and print-to-PDF. Good when notes already exist and you need slides fast; the output is a single file, no server.

summary.zh: 分析会议记录，评估发言表现并给出建议
summary.en: Analyze transcripts for talk ratio, filler words and avoidance habits.

description.zh: 读取 .vtt、.srt、.txt 或 Otter、Granola、Zoom 导出的会议记录，测算发言占比、口头禅和回避性表达，指出你在会上的表现并给出针对性建议。适合个人表达复盘、团队沟通改进或面试演练。
description.en: Reads transcripts from .vtt, .srt, .txt, Otter, Granola or Zoom, measures talk ratio, filler words and avoidance patterns, then coaches on how you come across. Useful for personal review, team communication and interview practice.

summary.zh: 判断该不该开会，折算成本并把笔记转成待办
summary.en: Decide if a meeting pays off, then agenda and actions

description.zh: 先判断这件事能否异步解决、时机是否未到，还是确实需要开会，并算出这次会议折算成多少钱。确定要开时排出以决策为先的议程；会后把杂乱笔记整理成带负责人和截止时间的行动项，没有归属的会被单独标出。
description.en: Gates a meeting as async, not ready or meet, prices it in dollars, then builds a decision-first agenda. After the meeting it turns messy notes into action items with an owner and due date, flagging orphans.

summary.zh: 多源交叉验证的深度调研并留存证据
summary.en: Triangulate every claim across sources and keep a reusable folder.

description.zh: 面向高风险判断的深度调研：先写出可证伪的假设，多路并行检索，每个结论至少用三个不同类型的来源交叉验证，并保存原文引述和来源文件。适合制定策略、比较多个产品或验证一个假设，且答案错了代价很高时使用。需要联网检索。
description.en: Deep research for costly decisions: falsifiable hypotheses, parallel searches, and every claim triangulated across three or more source types, with quotes and source files kept. Suits strategy and hypothesis tests. Needs web access.

summary.zh: 拆分合并、加水印、填表与提取 PDF 内容
summary.en: Split, merge, watermark, fill and extract content from PDFs.

description.zh: 覆盖 PDF 的文本与表格提取、合并拆分、旋转、加水印、加密解密和图片导出，也能为扫描件做 OCR 变成可搜索文本。适合整理合同、论文与扫描档案。使用前需要安装 PDF 处理依赖，OCR 还需额外语言包。
description.en: Handles text and table extraction, merging, splitting, rotation, watermarks, encryption and image export, plus OCR to make scans searchable. Suits contracts, papers and archived scans. Needs PDF libraries, and OCR needs language packs.

summary.zh: 创建、编辑并解析 PPTX 幻灯片
summary.en: Create, edit, parse and merge PowerPoint slide decks.

description.zh: 能从零做幻灯片，也能读取现有 .pptx 与 .potx 的文字和版式，改写内容、合并拆分文件，并保留讲者备注与批注。适合做提案汇报、复用模板或从演示稿里取内容。使用前需要安装演示文稿处理依赖。
description.en: Builds decks from scratch and edits existing .pptx or .potx files, combining or splitting them while keeping speaker notes and comments. Suits pitches, reports and template reuse. Requires presentation libraries installed.

summary.zh: 逐文件审查代码改动，给出合并前的缺陷与安全结论
summary.en: Review PRs file by file, flag bugs and risks, and give a merge verdict

description.zh: 逐个文件检查 Pull Request 的改动，指出潜在缺陷、安全问题和代码质量隐患，最后说明能否合并。适合在合并前做最后一轮把关，或接手不熟悉的改动时使用。需要能读取仓库和 PR 内容。
description.en: Walks a pull request file by file, pointing out bugs, security issues and quality problems, then states whether it is safe to merge. Useful as a final check before merging or when picking up unfamiliar changes. Needs repo and PR access.

summary.zh: 设计套餐层级与计费维度，测算收入影响
summary.en: Design tiers and value metrics, model revenue impact

description.zh: 为 SaaS 设计套餐分层、价值维度和功能打包，也可以评估涨价方案，先用模型测算不同选项对收入的影响。适合筹备定价页、调整计费方式或计划提价时使用。
description.en: Shapes SaaS tiers, value metrics and feature packaging, and models how each option affects revenue before numbers go public. Use it for a pricing page, a billing change or a price increase.

summary.zh: 用 RICE 排优先级，写 PRD 和访谈总结
summary.en: Prioritize with RICE, write PRDs, synthesize interviews

description.zh: 覆盖 RICE 优先级排序、客户访谈归纳、PRD 撰写和上市方案。适合在决定下一步做什么、给需求排期，或把访谈记录整理成结论时使用。
description.en: Covers RICE prioritization, customer interview synthesis, PRDs and go-to-market plans. Reach for it when deciding what to build next, ranking features or turning interview notes into decisions.

summary.zh: 重排现有 README 的第一屏与结构
summary.en: Audit and polish an existing README for scanning.

description.zh: 升级已有 README 的第一屏和整体结构：重写开头介绍、调整信息层级，按需补充徽章、Mermaid 图和折叠区块。会参照同一生态的头部项目做校准。适合说明已显陈旧或首屏平淡的仓库，不适用于从零新写或封面图设计。
description.en: Upgrades an existing README: rewrites the opening, reorders the information hierarchy and adds badges, Mermaid diagrams or collapsible sections, calibrated against leading repos in the same ecosystem. For stale READMEs, not from scratch.

summary.zh: 理性对待评审意见，先验证再动手改
summary.en: Handle review feedback by verifying it before changing code.

description.zh: 收到评审意见后先判断是否成立、是否值得改，必要时查证或复现，再决定采纳或说明理由。适合意见含糊、互相冲突或技术上存疑的场合，避免不加判断地照改一通。
description.en: Checks each review comment for validity and worth before acting, verifying or reproducing the issue where needed, then either applies the change or explains the disagreement. Fits vague, conflicting or technically doubtful feedback.

summary.zh: 从五个维度重看方向、假设与偏见
summary.en: Recheck direction, assumptions and bias from five angles

description.zh: 当工作已经沉到细节里，可以停下来从方向、假设、偏见等五个维度检查是否还在正轨上。适合阶段复盘、重大决定前的自查，或在长任务中途需要重新对齐时使用，不需要额外配置。
description.en: Steps back to reassess direction, assumptions and bias across five dimensions when work has sunk into detail. Useful mid-project or before a decision, to check the effort still serves the goal.

summary.zh: 在合并前发起评审，确认实现满足需求
summary.en: Request review before merging to confirm requirements are met.

description.zh: 在功能做完或准备合并时组织评审，说明改动范围与需要重点看的地方，让评审聚焦真实风险而不是格式细节。适合阶段完成与合并前的检查。
description.en: Organises a review once a feature is done or a merge is near, scoping the change and calling out where scrutiny matters, so feedback targets real risk rather than style. Fits milestone checks and pre-merge gates.

summary.zh: 把论文和报告压缩成要点并提取引用
summary.en: Condense papers and reports into briefs with citations

description.zh: 把论文、文章和报告压缩成简短摘要，对比多份材料并抽取引用条目。适合要快速读完一批文献，或为写作收集证据时使用。需要本地 Python 环境运行配套脚本。
description.en: Condenses papers, articles and reports into a short brief, compares several sources and pulls out citations. Use it to catch up on reading or gather evidence for a write-up. Runs on local Python scripts.

summary.zh: 判断调研类型，交给专用流程或自行检索
summary.en: Route a research request to a specialist or run a cited search.

description.zh: 接收宽泛的调研请求，判断它属于文献、专利、资助、竞品还是泛调研，交给对应流程，或者自己拆解问题、检索并给出带引用的结论。适合不确定该用哪种调研方法时先做分诊。需要联网检索。
description.en: Takes a broad research request, decides whether it belongs to literature, patents, grants, competitors or general search, and either hands off or runs its own cited plan. Good when you are unsure which method fits. Needs web access.

summary.zh: 解析招标需求并起草有实证支撑的应答
summary.en: Parse RFP requirements and draft proof-backed answers

description.zh: 收到 RFP、RFI、RFQ 或安全问卷后，区分必答项与加权评分项，按要点起草附有实证材料的应答，并估算中标概率。适合投标截止前的集中写作。
description.en: When an RFP, RFI, RFQ or security questionnaire arrives, it separates mandatory from weighted requirements, drafts answers backed by proof points and estimates win probability. Useful near a deadline.

summary.zh: 写路线图叙事、发布说明与干系人更新
summary.en: Write roadmap narratives, release notes and updates

description.zh: 撰写路线图叙事、发布说明、更新日志和面向不同对象的进展汇报。适合要把计划讲给高管、工程团队或客户听时使用。
description.en: Writes roadmap narratives, release notes, changelogs and stakeholder updates. Use it when explaining plans to executives, engineers or customers, each needing a different level of detail.

summary.zh: 核算增长指标并诊断 SaaS 经营状况
summary.en: Turns revenue numbers into SaaS metrics and a diagnosis

description.zh: 根据给出的收入或客户数据，计算 ARR、MRR、流失率、LTV、CAC 和净收入留存等指标，并算出快速比率和单位经济。适合融资、董事会汇报或判断增长是否健康时使用。
description.en: Turns revenue and customer numbers into ARR, MRR, churn, LTV, CAC and net revenue retention, plus quick ratio and unit economics. Useful for fundraising, board updates or checking whether growth is healthy.

summary.zh: 从难度和完成度两维给已完成工作打分
summary.en: Rate finished work on ambition and quality, without score inflation

description.zh: 对已完成的任务从目标难度和执行质量两个维度打分，用固定规则合成最终结果，并主动为偏高和偏低两种判断找理由。适合交付后想听真实评价，或需要跨项目保持一致的评分记录时使用。纯提示词运行，无需额外安装或配置。
description.en: Grades a finished task on ambition and execution quality, then combines them with a fixed rule while arguing against inflated and deflated marks. Use it for candid review after delivery or a consistent record across projects. Prompt-only.

summary.zh: 定位技术、页面与元标签问题，解释排名下滑
summary.en: Find technical and on-page causes of ranking drops

description.zh: 从技术配置、页面内容、元标签和站点健康度几个方面排查排名不佳的原因，并给出修复顺序。适合页面进不了搜索结果、流量突然下滑或需要做全面体检时使用。
description.en: Traces weak rankings through technical setup, on-page content, meta tags and site health, then ranks fixes. Use it when pages miss Google results, traffic drops or a full checkup is due.

summary.zh: 创建与更新技能的规范与脚手架
summary.en: Patterns and scaffolding for creating skills

description.zh:
为 AI 编码助手创建高质量技能：结构、输出模式与工作流。
侧重 Azure SDK 与 Microsoft Foundry 场景，含初始化、打包与校验脚本。
description.en:
Create high-quality skills for AI coding agents: structure, output patterns, and workflows.
Focused on Azure SDK and Microsoft Foundry scenarios, with init, package, and validation scripts.

summary.zh: 按各平台的开头、长度与格式写出社媒帖文
summary.en: Write posts and threads shaped to each platform's hook and format

description.zh: 写出 LinkedIn 帖文、X 长贴、Instagram 文案、TikTok 和 Facebook 帖文，按各平台的开头钩子、长度和版式来处理。适合需要一篇帖文，或把一个想法改写成多个平台版本时使用。
description.en: Writes LinkedIn posts, X threads, Instagram captions, TikTok and Facebook posts, each shaped by the platform's hook, length and format. Use it for a single post or to adapt one idea across several platforms.

summary.zh: 先写验收标准再编码，并从规格中提取测试
summary.en: Write the spec and acceptance criteria first, then derive tests

description.zh: 在动手写代码前先把功能写成规格：范围、验收标准、边界情况，再从规格里提取测试用例。适合需求含糊、多人协作容易理解不一致，或想用测试守住行为的时候。配套脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Writes a feature spec before coding, covering scope, acceptance criteria and edge cases, then extracts test cases from that spec. Use it when requirements are vague or several people must agree on behavior. Scripts need local Python.

summary.zh: 排查慢查询，改写 SQL，优化索引与迁移脚本
summary.en: Diagnose slow queries, rewrite SQL and tune indexes or ORM migrations.

description.zh: 针对慢查询或结果错误的 SQL，分析执行计划、索引和写法，给出改写方案；同时能处理 Prisma、Drizzle、SQLAlchemy 的迁移脚本。适合查询变慢、需要从零写一段 SQL，或迁移跑不过的时候。连接线上数据库需要你自行提供地址和权限。
description.en: Explains why a statement is slow or wrong from its plan, indexes and shape, then rewrites it. Also covers Prisma, Drizzle and SQLAlchemy migrations. Use it when a query needs writing or a migration won't run. Database access comes from you.

summary.zh: 判断 A/B 差异是真实提升还是随机波动
summary.en: Separate a real A/B lift from noise using significance tests

description.zh: 用显著性检验和置信区间判断 A/B 结果里的差异是真实提升还是随机波动，并给出所需样本量和测试时长。适合质疑某个指标的变化、判断哪个版本胜出，或设计下一次实验时使用。
description.en: Uses significance tests, confidence intervals, sample size and test duration to separate a real A/B lift from noise. Use it to challenge a metric move, pick the winning variant or size the next experiment.

summary.zh: 为课程大纲补充近期同行评议论文与阅读材料
summary.en: Adds recent peer-reviewed papers to a course syllabus

description.zh: 读取课程大纲或教学提纲，按主题分组查找近期同行评议论文，最后输出一份含摘要和讨论题的 Word 文档。适合备课时补充阅读材料，或为学生整理延伸阅读。需要联网检索文献。
description.en: Takes a course syllabus or outline, groups the topics, finds recent peer-reviewed papers and writes a Word document with summaries and discussion questions. Useful for building reading lists. Needs internet access.

summary.zh: 用可复现的流程定位 bug 根因
summary.en: Trace bugs to their root cause

description.zh:
遇到 bug、测试失败或意外行为时，先建立可复现证据，再沿调用链追到根因。
强调先改测试复现、再做最小修复，避免拍脑袋改代码。
description.en:
When a bug, failing test, or unexpected behavior shows up, reproduce it first, then trace the call chain to the root cause.
Emphasizes a failing test followed by the smallest fix instead of guessing.

summary.zh: 先写测试再写实现的开发与补测流程
summary.en: Test-first development and test generation across stacks

description.zh: 按红绿重构的节奏推进开发：先写失败的测试，再实现功能，最后整理结构；也支持给已有代码补测试。适配 Jest、Pytest、JUnit、Vitest 与 Mocha，适合需要 mock 依赖或提高覆盖率时使用。
description.en: Drives development in red-green-refactor steps: a failing test first, then the implementation, then cleanup, plus backfilling tests for existing code. Covers Jest, Pytest, JUnit, Vitest and Mocha.

summary.zh: 起草周报、公告与 FAQ 等内部沟通稿
summary.en: Draft 3P updates, status notes, newsletters and incident reports.

description.zh: 根据受众和场合起草 3P 更新、周报、状态同步、内部通讯、FAQ 和事故通报，对齐格式与详略程度。适合每周固定同步、跨部门通知或向管理层汇报时使用。
description.en: Drafts 3P updates, weekly and status reports, newsletters, FAQs and incident write-ups in the format each audience expects. Useful for weekly rhythms, cross-team announcements and leadership updates.

summary.zh: 先写测试再写实现
summary.en: Write the test before the code

description.zh:
在写实现代码前先写会失败的测试，用红-绿-重构推进功能与修复。
包含如何写出好的测试与常见反模式。
适合任何新功能或 bug 修复。
description.en:
Write a failing test first, then implement, using red-green-refactor for features and fixes.
Covers how to write good tests and common anti-patterns.
Works for any new feature or bug fix.

summary.zh: 为幻灯片和文档套用统一的配色与字体
summary.en: Apply consistent color and type themes to decks and documents.

description.zh: 提供 10 套预设配色与字体搭配，选定后统一套用到幻灯片、文档、报告或网页上，也能按需生成一套新主题。适合需要成套视觉风格但不想逐页调样式的场景。
description.en: Ships ten preset palettes with font pairings, applied consistently across slides, documents, reports or web pages, and can compose a new theme on request. Suits work that needs a coherent look without restyling page by page.

summary.zh: 建立 design token、组件文档与响应式规范
summary.en: Build design tokens, component docs and responsive scales

description.zh: 从 design token 到组件文档和响应式尺度，搭起一套可交付的设计系统。适合新产品统一视觉语言，或需要把设计规范交接给开发时使用。
description.en: Builds a design system from tokens through component docs, responsive scales and developer handoff. Use it to unify a visual language across a product or to prepare specs for engineering.

summary.zh: 声称完成前先跑验证并给出证据
summary.en: Run the checks before claiming done

description.zh:
在说「做完了/修好了/测试通过」之前，先运行验证命令并核对输出。
要求用证据代替断言，避免未经验证的完成声明。
description.en:
Before saying done, fixed, or passing, run the verification commands and check the output.
Evidence before assertions: never claim success without running it.

summary.zh: 规划视频选题、开场钩子和分平台的分发方式
summary.en: Plan video hooks, structure and per-platform reuse before scripting

description.zh: 在写脚本之前先定视频策略：受众、开场钩子、内容结构，以及一条长内容如何拆成分平台的短视频。适合做 YouTube 选题、Reels、TikTok、Shorts 系列，或把长文和播客转成视频时使用。
description.en: Sets video strategy before any scripting: audience, hook, structure, and how one long piece splits into platform-specific clips. Fits YouTube planning, Reels, TikTok and Shorts series, or turning articles and podcasts into video.

summary.zh: 用字体、色彩、间距建立统一视觉
summary.en: Typography, color, spacing, and iconography fundamentals.

description.zh: 从字体排布、色彩理论、间距体系和图标风格入手，建立一套前后一致的视觉规则。适合制定设计规范、整理设计令牌，或改善界面的层级与一致性。
description.en: Establishes consistent visual rules from typography, color theory, spacing systems, and iconography. Useful for style guides, design tokens, or fixing hierarchy and consistency in an existing interface.

summary.zh: 清理未闭环事项，评估项目与承诺的健康度
summary.en: Close open loops and score commitment health

description.zh: 按清空、对齐、展望三个阶段走一遍每周复盘，盘出所有未闭环的事项，用清单逐项确认缺口，并给出承诺健康度评分。适合周末收尾、系统开始不信任，或复盘习惯中断后重新启动时使用，需要本地 Python 3 环境。
description.en: Runs a three-phase weekly review: inventories open loops, flags named gaps on a checklist and scores commitment health. Good for a weekly close, restarting a lapsed habit or when your system feels untrustworthy.

summary.zh: 把需求拆成可执行的步骤
summary.en: Turn requirements into executable steps

description.zh:
当需求已明确但改动跨多个步骤时，先写出分阶段、可验证的实施计划。
计划包含任务拆分、顺序与每步的验证方式，再开始动代码。
description.en:
When requirements are clear but the change spans multiple steps, write a staged, verifiable plan first.
Plans cover task breakdown, ordering, and how to verify each step before code changes.

summary.zh: 编写、修改并验证技能文档是否可用
summary.en: Write, revise and verify that a skill definition works.

description.zh: 说明技能文档的结构、触发条件与写法要点，并给出交付前的验证方法。适合新建技能或修改已有技能时对照，避免写完却在实际任务里不生效。
description.en: Covers how to structure a skill, phrase its trigger conditions and keep it focused, along with ways to verify it before shipping. Useful when adding a new skill or revising an existing one that never fires as intended.

summary.zh: 读写编辑表格，清理并重组杂乱数据
summary.en: Read, edit and clean spreadsheet files and tabular data.

description.zh: 支持 .xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 的读取、写入与公式计算，可修掉错行错列、合并表头之类的脏数据，也能从零建表并设置格式与图表。适合交付规范表格或修复他人表格。使用前需要安装表格处理依赖。
description.en: Reads, writes and recalculates .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files, cleaning messy rows, misplaced headers and junk data, and building sheets with formatting and charts from scratch. Requires spreadsheet libraries installed.

summary.zh: 高风险编码前先规划，逐个核对用到的 API 是否真实存在
summary.en: Plan risky coding work and confirm every API exists before coding

description.zh: 在认证、数据库迁移这类高风险改动前先做规划，拆出步骤并逐个核对用到的 import 与接口是否真实存在。适合多文件修改、旧系统改造，或需求里容易凭空编造接口的场景。改动很小时不必启用。
description.en: Plans high-stakes work such as auth changes, migrations and multi-file edits, then checks that every import and API really exists. Use it when a task is complex enough that invented interfaces are a real risk. Small edits do not need it.

summary.zh: 读写 Airtable 数据库与记录
summary.en: Read and write Airtable bases and records

description.zh:
连接 Airtable 作为数据库与操作层，查询、创建和更新记录。
适合把表格数据接入对话流程。
description.en:
Use Airtable as a database and operations layer: query, create, and update records.
Good for bringing table data into the conversation.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Airtable 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Airtable in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 调用万级爬虫与自动化工具
summary.en: Run scrapers and automations from Apify

description.zh:

可以创建分支、查看连接串并执行 SQL。
description.en:
Manage Neon projects, branches, and Lakebase Postgres databases through the official MCP server.
Create branches, read connection strings, and run SQL.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Neon 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Neon in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 管理站点部署与构建日志
summary.en: Manage site deploys and build logs

description.zh: 查看站点、部署记录与构建日志，创建新部署并读取环境变量。适合发布静态站点后排查失败或回滚。首次连接在浏览器登录 Netlify 授权。
description.en: Inspect sites, deploy history, and build logs, create new deploys, and read environment variables. Useful for debugging a failed static site build or rolling back. Sign in to Netlify in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Netlify 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Netlify and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 搜索与编辑 Notion 页面、数据库
summary.en: Search and edit Notion pages and databases

description.zh:
连接 Notion 工作区，搜索页面并按需创建或更新内容。
适合把会议记录、知识库与项目资料接入对话。
description.en:
Connect your Notion workspace to search pages and create or update content on demand.
Useful for bringing meeting notes, knowledge bases, and project docs into the conversation.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Notion 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Notion in the browser and authorize on first connect.

summary.zh: 检索论文、作者与引用关系
summary.en: Search works, authors, and citations

description.zh: 检索学术论文、作者、机构与引用关系，返回开放获取链接与摘要。适合做文献综述或查证研究来源。首次连接在浏览器完成 OpenAlex 授权。
description.en: Search scholarly works, authors, institutions, and citation links, with open access links and abstracts. Useful for literature reviews or verifying where a claim comes from. OpenAlex consent happens in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 OpenAlex 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to OpenAlex and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 查看事件、值班表与服务状态
summary.en: Check incidents, on-call, and services

description.zh: 查询事件、服务、值班表与升级策略，也能创建或更新事件。适合值班时确认谁在班、事件进展如何。首次连接在浏览器登录 PagerDuty 授权。
description.en: Look up incidents, services, on-call schedules, and escalation policies, and create or update incidents. Useful during on-call to see who is covering and how an incident is progressing. Sign in to PagerDuty in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 PagerDuty 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to PagerDuty and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 查询交易、发票与支付状态
summary.en: Look up transactions, invoices, and payments

description.zh: 读取交易、订单与发票记录，查询结算和退款状态。适合核对收款或排查支付失败。首次连接在浏览器登录 PayPal 商家账号授权。
description.en: Read transactions, orders, and invoices, and check settlement and refund status. Useful for reconciling incoming payments or tracing a failed charge. Sign in with a PayPal business account on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 PayPal 商家账号并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to your PayPal business account and authorize

summary.zh: 实时网页搜索与研究
summary.en: Real-time web search and research

description.zh:
通过 Perplexity API 做实时网页搜索、推理与研究，返回带来源的答案。
连接时需要 Perplexity API Key。
description.en:
Run real-time web search, reasoning, and research through the Perplexity API, with answers that cite sources.
Requires a Perplexity API key.

authHint.zh: 需要 Perplexity API Key，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires a Perplexity API key; you'll be asked for it when connecting.

summary.zh: 查询账户余额与交易明细
summary.en: Check account balances and transactions

description.zh: 对已链接账户查询余额、交易与账户信息，用于核对流水或调试接入。适合开发和数据分析场景。先在 Plaid 控制台生成访问令牌，再填入连接配置。
description.en: Query balances, transactions, and account details for linked accounts, for reconciliation or integration debugging. Aimed at development and data analysis work. Create an access token in the Plaid dashboard first, then add it to the connection.

authHint.zh: 在 Plaid 控制台生成访问令牌后填入
authHint.en: Create an access token in the Plaid dashboard

summary.zh: 产品分析、功能开关与实验数据
summary.en: Product analytics, feature flags, and experiments

description.zh:
查询 PostHog 的产品分析、功能开关、实验与错误数据。
连接时需要 PostHog API Token。
description.en:
Query PostHog product analytics, feature flags, experiments, and error data.
Requires a PostHog API token.

authHint.zh: 需要 PostHog API Token，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires a PostHog API token; you'll be asked for it when connecting.

summary.zh: 运行集合、查看接口与工作区
summary.en: Run collections and browse APIs

description.zh: 读取工作区、集合与接口定义，执行请求并查看环境变量。适合调试第三方接口，或把已有集合当作接口文档查询。连接时在请求头填入 Postman API Key。
description.en: Read workspaces, collections, and API definitions, run requests, and inspect environment variables. Useful for debugging third-party APIs or treating an existing collection as documentation. Supply a Postman API key in the request header.

authHint.zh: 在 Postman 账号设置里生成 API Key 后填入
authHint.en: Generate an API key in your Postman account settings

summary.zh: 查看服务状态与部署日志
summary.en: Inspect services and deployment logs

description.zh: 读取项目、服务、环境与部署状态，查看日志并触发重新部署。适合在手机上跟进后端服务。首次连接在浏览器完成 Railway 授权。
description.en: Read projects, services, environments, and deployment status, view logs, and trigger redeploys. Handy for following a backend service from a phone. Railway authorization happens in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Railway 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Railway and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 查询公司卡消费与报销
summary.en: Inspect card spend and reimbursements

description.zh: 读取公司卡交易、报销单与预算使用情况，可按商户或时间筛选。适合核对支出或准备月度汇总。首次连接在浏览器登录 Ramp 授权。
description.en: Read card transactions, reimbursement requests, and budget usage, filtered by merchant or date. Useful for checking spend or preparing a monthly summary. Sign in to Ramp in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Ramp 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Ramp and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 扫描代码安全与质量问题
summary.en: Scan code for security and quality issues

description.zh: 对仓库或代码片段运行规则扫描，返回安全漏洞、代码异味及规则说明。适合合并前做静态检查，或在对话里解释某条告警。首次连接用 Semgrep 账号在浏览器授权。
description.en: Run rule-based scans on repositories or snippets and get back findings plus rule explanations. Useful for pre-merge static checks or explaining a specific alert in conversation. Authorize with your Semgrep account in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Semgrep 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Semgrep and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 查看错误、性能与发布记录
summary.en: Inspect errors, performance traces, and releases

description.zh: 查询项目的错误事件、堆栈、性能追踪与发布版本。适合线上报错后拉取上下文、确认影响范围。首次连接在浏览器登录 Sentry 并选择组织授权。
description.en: Query error events, stack traces, performance traces, and releases for your projects. Useful for pulling context after a production error and checking impact. Sign in to Sentry and pick an organization on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Sentry 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Sentry and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 搜索消息、频道与成员
summary.en: Search messages, channels, and members

description.zh: 在工作区里搜索消息与文件、读取频道历史和成员信息，并可发送消息。适合查找历史讨论或把结论同步到频道。首次连接在浏览器登录 Slack 授权。
description.en: Search messages and files, read channel history and member profiles, and post messages. Useful for finding an earlier discussion or sharing a conclusion back to a channel. Sign in to Slack in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Slack 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Slack and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 管理表格、行与附件
summary.en: Manage sheets, rows, and attachments

description.zh: 读取和更新表格、行、列与附件，按条件查询项目数据。适合跟进共享表格里的排期与状态。首次连接在浏览器登录 Smartsheet 授权。
description.en: Read and update sheets, rows, columns, and attachments, and query project data with filters. Useful for tracking schedules and status kept in shared sheets. Sign in to Smartsheet in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Smartsheet 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Smartsheet and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 查看订单、支付与商品
summary.en: View orders, payments, and catalog items

description.zh: 读取订单、支付、商品目录与客户信息，支持创建订单和退款。适合门店对账或查某笔交易。首次连接在浏览器登录 Square 授权。
description.en: Read orders, payments, catalog items, and customers, and create orders or refunds. Useful for store reconciliation or tracing a single transaction. Sign in to Square in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Square 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Square and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 管理站点页面与商品内容
summary.en: Manage site pages and product content

description.zh: 读取站点页面、博客与商品信息，更新内容并检查发布状态。适合维护作品集或小型商店。连接时完成 Squarespace 授权并选择站点。
description.en: Read site pages, blog posts, and products, update content, and check publish state. Useful for maintaining a portfolio or small shop. Authorize and pick a site when connecting.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Squarespace 并选择站点
authHint.en: Sign in to Squarespace and choose a site on first connect

summary.zh: 查看训练记录与体能趋势
summary.en: Review activities and fitness trends

description.zh: 读取活动记录、里程、配速与体能趋势，按时间或运动类型筛选。适合复盘训练或安排下周计划。首次连接在浏览器登录 Strava 授权，需要有效订阅。
description.en: Read activities, distance, pace, and fitness trends, filtered by date or sport. Useful for reviewing training or planning the next week. Sign in to Strava on first connect; an active subscription is required.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Strava 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Strava and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 管理客户、商品、支付与发票
summary.en: Manage customers, products, payments, and invoices

description.zh:
通过 Stripe 官方 MCP 管理客户、商品、支付与发票等数据。
连接时需要提供 Stripe API Key，请按服务提示授权。
description.en:
Manage customers, products, payments, and invoices through Stripe's official MCP server.
You'll need a Stripe API key; follow the prompt to authorize the connection.

authHint.zh: 需要 Stripe API Key，连接时按提示填写。
authHint.en: Requires a Stripe API key; you'll be asked for it when connecting.

summary.zh: 查询数据库、表结构与日志
summary.en: Query databases, schemas, and logs

description.zh: 对项目执行 SQL 查询、查看表结构与迁移，读取日志和边缘函数信息。适合排查数据问题或确认线上结构。首次连接在浏览器登录 Supabase 授权，可只授权单个项目。
description.en: Run SQL queries, inspect schemas and migrations, and read logs and edge function details. Useful for chasing data issues or confirming production structure. Sign in to Supabase in the browser and scope access to a single project if you prefer.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Supabase 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Supabase and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 检索网页并提取可引用正文
summary.en: Web search with citable page extracts

description.zh: 执行网页搜索、提取页面正文并返回可直接引用的片段。适合需要来源支撑的问答与事实核对。首次连接在浏览器登录 Tavily 授权。
description.en: Run web searches, extract page content, and return excerpts that can be cited. Useful for answers that need sources and for fact checking. Sign in to Tavily in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Tavily 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Tavily and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 地址解析、路线规划与周边搜索
summary.en: Geocoding, routing, and nearby search

description.zh: 提供地址与坐标互转、驾车步行路线规划、周边地点搜索与天气查询。适合出行规划或按位置找店。填好地址即可连接。
description.en: Convert between addresses and coordinates, plan driving and walking routes, search nearby places, and check weather. Useful for trip planning or finding shops by location. Connect with the URL alone.

authHint.zh: 无需授权，填好地址即可连接
authHint.en: No sign-in needed, connect with the URL

summary.zh: 查询企业工商与风险信息
summary.en: Look up company registry and risk data

description.zh: 按企业名称查询工商登记、股东、对外投资、司法与经营风险信息。适合合作前做背景核查。首次连接跳转天眼查账号登录并授权。
description.en: Look up registration details, shareholders, investments, litigation, and operating risk for a company. Useful for background checks before a partnership. Tianyancha sign-in and consent happen in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接跳转天眼查登录并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Tianyancha and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 添加与整理待办任务
summary.en: Add and organize to-do tasks

description.zh: 读取项目与任务、添加待办、修改截止时间与优先级并完成任务。适合随手把想法记成任务再统一安排。首次连接在浏览器登录 Todoist 授权。
description.en: Read projects and tasks, add to-dos, adjust due dates and priority, and complete tasks. Good for capturing ideas as tasks and sorting them later. Sign in to Todoist in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Todoist 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Todoist and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 管理部署、项目与环境变量
summary.en: Manage deployments, projects, and env vars

description.zh: 列出项目与部署、查看构建日志、读写环境变量，并可触发重新部署。适合排查线上构建失败或确认发布状态。首次连接在浏览器登录 Vercel 授权。
description.en: List projects and deployments, read build logs, read and update environment variables, and trigger redeploys. Useful for diagnosing failed builds or confirming what is live. Sign in to Vercel in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Vercel 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Vercel and authorize on first connect

summary.zh: 管理站点内容与集合条目
summary.en: Manage site content and CMS items

description.zh: 读取站点、页面与 CMS 集合，创建和更新内容条目。适合批量维护博客或产品页文案。首次连接在浏览器登录 Webflow 授权并选择站点。
description.en: Read sites, pages, and CMS collections, and create or update items. Useful for bulk-editing blog posts or product page copy. Sign in to Webflow and pick a site on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Webflow 并选择站点
authHint.en: Sign in to Webflow and choose a site on first connect

summary.zh: 管理站点内容与订单
summary.en: Manage site content and orders

description.zh: 读取和修改站点的商品、订单、博客与页面内容。适合维护小型网店或落地页。首次连接在浏览器登录 Wix 授权并选择站点。
description.en: Read and update products, orders, blog posts, and page content on a Wix site. Useful for maintaining a small shop or landing page. Sign in to Wix and choose a site on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Wix 并选择站点
authHint.en: Sign in to Wix and choose a site on first connect

summary.zh: 查看账目、发票与联系人
summary.en: View accounts, invoices, and contacts

description.zh: 读取组织的科目表、发票、账单与联系人，查询账目余额。适合小企业财务核对。首次连接在浏览器登录 Xero 授权并选择组织。
description.en: Read chart of accounts, invoices, bills, and contacts, and check account balances. Useful for small business bookkeeping checks. Sign in to Xero and choose an organization on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Xero 并选择组织
authHint.en: Sign in to Xero and choose an organization on first connect

summary.zh: 连接 9000+ 应用与 4 万+ 自动化动作
summary.en: Connect 9,000+ apps and 40,000+ actions

description.zh:
通过 Zapier 把助手连接到 9,000 多个应用，执行 40,000 多种自动化动作。
首次连接需在浏览器登录 Zapier 并完成授权。
description.en:
Connect the assistant to 9,000+ apps and run 40,000+ actions through Zapier.
Sign in to Zapier in the browser and authorize on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接需在浏览器登录 Zapier 并授权。
authHint.en: Sign in to Zapier in the browser and authorize on first connect.
